sourceDocuments.title: National Bureau of Statistics Informal Economy Assessment
sourceDocuments.text: The Nigerian informal sector accounts for over fifty-seven percent of rebased gross domestic product and employs approximately eighty percent of the active labor force in non-agricultural microenterprises.
